snippet.title: Stella Astrum - Official Release Sept 25th 2026
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5045010/Stella_Astrum/
Stella Astrum is a whimsical factory game where you manage elemental resources to form Stars, Planets, and more. Use your skills to unlock upgradable factories, nurture colorful celestial bodies, and shape an expansive galaxy. Sit back, relax, and amplify the universe beyond its artistic limits!

This game was made in 31 days by a small group of Indie developers. Hope you enjoy!
